scenes.say: Azure has four main load-balancing services. Which one should you use for your app?

rows.b: Regional, Layer 4, any TCP or UDP

scenes.say: Here are your options: Load Balancer for any TCP or UDP, App Gateway for web and TLS, Front Door for global apps, and Traffic Manager for DNS-based failover.
Regional services handle local traffic, while global ones route across continents. Choose based on where your users are.

scenes.question: Why did all your backends go down?
scenes.right: A custom network rule blocked Azure health probes, marking every backend as down.
scenes.say: Interview trap: If all backends show as down, check your network security rules. Blocking Azure health probes can cause this.
